GUMAS_Full_Team_Roster_Final.html.html:
GUMAS Full Team Roster

Dr. Amelia Rivers
AI Systems Specialist (Original Panel)
Provided the initial structured integration insights and detailed guidelines for the memory optimization module’s core architecture.
Prof. Elena Sorensen
Cognitive Science & Narrative Expert (Original Panel)
Focused on ensuring that the simulation’s memory system mirrors realistic human memory behavior through selective forgetting, conflict resolution, and narrative summarization.
Dr. Kieran Zhao
Computational Optimization Expert (Original Panel)
Contributed critical expertise in optimizing algorithms and data structures to ensure efficient and scalable memory retrieval and decay mechanisms.
Alex Thorne
Project Manager & AI Systems Architect (Memory Module Lead)
Oversees overall design, integration, and strategic alignment of the memory module, ensuring all components meet performance and narrative requirements.
Samantha Lee
Logging & Observability Engineer
Designs and implements the advanced logging framework to capture memory lifecycle events and performance metrics for real-time observability.
Marcus Chen
Performance Optimization Engineer
Fine-tunes memory retrieval algorithms and indexing strategies, ensuring fast, scalable access to memory data even as simulation complexity increases.
Emily Roberts
LLM-to-Simulation Bridge Developer
Develops and maintains the interface between the memory system and the narrative AI, optimizing prompt integration and ensuring critical contextual information is available.
Jessica Martinez
Senior Backend Developer
Designs robust backend systems and scalable APIs to ensure seamless integration of the memory module with other simulation data management services.
Ryan Patel
Systems Integration Engineer
Ensures smooth data flow between the memory module and other subsystems, resolving interface issues and maintaining overall system consistency.
Olivia Nguyen
Quality Assurance & Testing Engineer
Develops and executes comprehensive test plans to validate the robustness and performance of the memory module, ensuring all components meet quality standards.
